blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Estimating accident mechanics from real-world crashes is important for vehicle-safety analysis, injury modeling, and crash-severity prediction. It can also support operational workflows such as insurance claim triage. In standard crash records, key metadata such as impact configuration, principal direction of force, and change in velocity ( Δ ​ V \Delta V ) may be missing, delayed, or corrupted. By contrast, post-crash photographs are widely available and contain rich visual evidence of deformation. This raises the following question: how much crash mechanics information can be recovered directly from vehicle photos when structured signals are absent? To study this, we formulate crash understanding as supervised prediction from per-case multi-view photo sets. Targets include six Collision Deformation Classification (CDC) descriptors and the longitudinal/lateral components of reconstructed Δ ​ V \Delta V . Each photo is encoded by a shared visual backbone, and the resulting view-level features are fused into a single case-level representation from which target-specific heads predict crash descriptors. Using 15.2k training cases from the Crash Investigation Sampling System ( ≈ \approx 1.5M photos before filtering), 1.15k validation cases, and 1.15k test cases, we define an evaluation protocol for vision-based crash descriptor estimation from incomplete multi-view evidence. Post-crash imagery alone provides usable signal for several non-trivial crash-mechanics descriptors, while weakly observable and long-tailed targets remain challenging. Within the compared training regimes, the selected joint-training recipe improves several context-dependent targets under this protocol, reducing mean absolute angular error for principal direction of force from 20.1 ∘ 20.1^{\circ} to 14.05 ∘ 14.05^{\circ} and lowering longitudinal Δ ​ V \Delta V MAE from 8.04 8.04 to 7.45 7.45 km/h. Our work provides a reference point for future multimodal fusion with structured crash metadata.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Traffic accidents remain a major public health and safety challenge, causing high rates of fatalities and injuries. Improving the analysis and prediction of crash outcomes is crucial for enhancing road safety, reducing casualties, and supporting more reliable crash reconstruction and interpretation. Active and passive safety systems, such as adaptive airbags, electronic stability control, and automated collision-avoidance systems, have improved substantially over the last decades. However, assessing how these systems perform in real-world crashes still requires accurate reconstruction of the underlying collision mechanics, information that is often absent or incomplete in standard crash records. Moreover, the parameters that describe these mechanics are often not directly measurable in real-world crashes, and many lower severity collisions go unreported (e.g., because they do not require a vehicle tow) [ 15 ] .
blocks.zh: 交通事故仍然是对公众健康和安全的一大挑战,造成很高的伤亡率。 改进对坠机结果的分析和预测,对于加强道路安全、减少伤亡、支持更可靠的坠机重建和解释至关重要。 过去几十年中,主动和被动的安全系统,如适应性气囊、电子稳定性控制和自动避免相撞系统,已大有改进。 然而,评估这些系统在现实世界相撞中的表现仍然需要精确地重建基本的相撞力学,而在标准相撞记录中往往缺少或不完整的信息. 此外,描述这些力学的参数在现实世界的相撞中往往无法直接测量,许多轻度相撞事件没有报告(例如,因为它们不需要车辆拖走)[15].

blocks.en: Beyond accident mechanics analysis itself, these crash descriptors are important inputs to downstream risk-modeling and triage pipelines. Unfortunately, they are typically available only after Event Data Recorder (EDR) extraction or crash reconstruction. By contrast, photographs are often among the earliest and most consistently available information channels. This motivates our study of image-based estimation from post-crash photo sets. In this work, we investigate how much of the underlying kinematic information can be recovered from images when structured signals are missing or delayed, and whether such estimates can serve as inputs to injury and severity models that would otherwise rely on structured metadata.

blocks.en: Furthermore, we define crash understanding as multi-target prediction from post-crash photo sets. We predict deformation descriptors derived from the Collision Deformation Classification (CDC) code [ 23 ] (Table 1 ) together with directional Δ ​ V \Delta V components. These targets capture complementary aspects of collision geometry and dynamics and are commonly used as informative inputs to downstream injury and severity models. To study this setting, we use a unified multi-view architecture built on a SwinV2 backbone [ 13 ] with case-level fusion. We compare separate single-task training with a joint-training pipeline under a common input representation and evaluation protocol. As previewed in Figure 1 , the selected joint-training configuration improves several of the most context-dependent targets.

blocks.en: In summary, this paper makes three contributions: (i) it introduces a CISS-based evaluation protocol for crash descriptor estimation from real-world, naturally incomplete multi-view post-crash photo sets; (ii) it defines a preprocessing and case-construction pipeline for mapping heterogeneous crash photographs into fixed canonical view slots with masked supervision for missing labels; and (iii) it reports single-task and joint-training reference results for CDC-derived crash descriptors and reconstructed Δ ​ V \Delta V components. Our goal is not to propose a new vision backbone, but to establish a controlled and reproducible reference point for image-based crash-mechanics estimation and future multimodal fusion with structured crash metadata.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Most prior crash-severity and injury prediction pipelines operate on structured crash records rather than images. Across this literature, kinematic variables such as change in velocity ( Δ ​ V \Delta V ), principal direction of force, and peak acceleration are consistently treated as informative predictors alongside vehicle, occupant, roadway, and environmental factors [ 9 , 3 , 22 , 18 , 16 , 7 ] . In particular, prior studies identify Δ ​ V \Delta V and related crash-mechanics descriptors as important signals for injury estimation and severity modeling [ 9 , 3 ] . However, these quantities are usually assumed to be available from event data recorders, reconstruction pipelines, or investigator-coded records, rather than inferred directly from visual evidence.
blocks.zh: 大多数先前的相撞-相撞-相撞和相撞预测管道都运行在结构化相撞记录上,而不是图像上. 在整个文献中,动能变量,如速度变化(QQ V \ Delta V),主要武力方向,和峰值加速等,始终被当作信息预测器,与车辆,占地者,出行道,以及环境因素相伴[9,3,22,18,16,7]. 特别是,先前的研究确定,XQ V \Delta V 及相关的相撞机械描述符是估计伤害和严重性模型的重要信号[9,3]. 然而,通常假定这些数量来自事件数据记录器、重建管道或调查员编码的记录,而不是直接取自视觉证据。

blocks.en: A smaller line of work addresses the missing-variable problem itself. Statistical reconstruction methods are used to correct reporting bias and infer unobserved crash quantities from structured records [ 15 ] . More broadly, most severity-prediction research still learns from tabular crash databases, police reports, and coded driver/vehicle/roadway variables, using both classical statistical models and modern machine-learning methods [ 18 , 22 , 16 , 7 ] . In these settings, crash-mechanics variables serve as inputs when available, not as prediction targets. Our focus is different: we study whether such descriptors can be recovered directly from post-crash photographs when structured signals are absent, delayed, or incomplete.
blocks.zh: 较小的一行工作解决了缺少的可变问题本身。 统计重建方法用于纠正报告偏差,并推断结构化记录中未观察到的坠毁数量[15]. 更广泛地说,大多数严重程度预测研究仍然从表格式坠机数据库、警察报告和编码的司机/车辆/公路变量中学习,同时使用古典统计模型和现代机器学习方法[18、22、16、7]。 在这些环境下,崩溃-机械变量在可用时作为投入,而不是作为预测目标. 我们的焦点不同:我们研究当结构化的信号缺失,延迟或不完整时,这种描述符是否能够从崩溃后的照片中直接取出.

blocks.en: An even more limited amount of work attempts to infer crash characteristics directly from post-crash images. Existing image-based methods typically focus on a narrow output space such as impact location or Δ ​ V \Delta V , curated single-image settings, or supplement images with synthetic data or vehicle metadata [ 25 , 8 ] . The closest studies are Silver et al. [ 25 ] , who combine real and synthetic crash images, and Hasija et al. [ 8 ] , who use a curated frontal-only subset together with vehicle metadata. In contrast, we study real-world crash cases represented by naturally incomplete multi-view photo sets and predict multiple CDC-derived descriptors together with reconstructed Δ ​ V \Delta V components. Our goal is not to claim direct comparability with these settings, but to provide a reference point for image-based crash understanding at real-world scale.

blocks.en: Datasets suitable for this task are limited. The problem requires crash records with post-crash photographs together with supervisory targets that describe collision mechanics. Nonetheless, we identified three repositories that provide this combination at scale: NHTSA’s CISS/NASS-CDS in the United States, Germany’s GIDAS, and India’s RASSI [ 17 , 5 , 21 ] .

blocks.en: We use NHTSA’s Crash Investigation Sampling System (CISS) dataset, because it is openly available, large, standardized, and richly documented with post-crash imagery. Although GIDAS and RASSI also pair crash records with photographs, we excluded GIDAS due to access constraints and did not use RASSI because its road and traffic environment differs substantially from our target setting. Each retained CISS case includes structured forms and typically dozens of scene and vehicle photographs. From the available records, we construct a CISS-based evaluation setup of 17.5k crash cases ( ≈ \approx 1.5M photos before filtering).

blocks.en: 4 Methods
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: Our goal is to predict crash descriptors from post-crash photo sets, so the core of the model is a shared visual encoder followed by case-level multi-view fusion. We use SwinV2 as the backbone for all post-crash views for three reasons. First, it provides hierarchical representations, preserving local cues in early stages while aggregating broader context, which is useful when the evidence is subtle, spatially localized, or low-contrast against the vehicle body (e.g., cracks, panel gaps, broken lamps). Second, its window-based self-attention captures longer-range interactions while remaining computationally feasible at the image resolution used in this study compared to global-attention vision transformers [ 4 ] . Third, SwinV2 supports interpolation of pretrained positional information, allowing fine-tuning at a different input size while still benefiting from pretrained weights [ 13 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们的目标是从相机发生后的照片集中预测崩溃描述符,所以模型的核心是共享的视觉编码符,然后是案例级多视图聚变. 我们使用SwinV2作为所有碰撞后视图的骨干,原因有三. 首先,它提供分级的表示,在早期阶段保留了局部提示,同时汇总了更广泛的上下文,当证据是细微的,空间局部的,或者与车辆车体相撞的低相干(如裂缝,板隙,断灯等)时,这种上下文是有用的. 第二,其基于窗口的自觉性能够捕捉更远的相互作用,同时与全局性视觉变压器相比,在本研究所使用的图像分辨率上仍然具有计算可行性[4]. 第三点 SwinV2支持对被预先训练的位置信息进行内插,允许在不同的输入大小上进行微调,同时仍然受益于预先训练的重量 [13].

blocks.en: Each crash case is represented by up to nine post-crash views, with the image order assigned using the dataset’s viewpoint labels. When a canonical viewpoint is unavailable, the corresponding slot remains empty. This fixed ordering is important because it preserves viewpoint identity across cases and allows the fusion module to associate each feature vector with a consistent semantic position. We use metadata-based slots in the main experiments to keep crash descriptor prediction separate from possible viewpoint estimation errors. ESM Table 2 reports an automatic orientation-based slot assignment variant, which matches the metadata-based slots at the reported precision when averaged over three runs.
blocks.zh: 每个崩溃案例都由多达9个崩溃后视图代表,图像顺序使用数据集的视角标签来指定. 当一个犬形视图无法使用时,相应的空位仍然为空. 这种固定的顺序很重要,因为它保留了不同情况下的视角身份,并允许聚变模块将每个特性向量与一致的语义位置相连接. 我们在主要实验中使用基于元数据的插槽,使崩溃描述器预测与可能的观点估计错误分开. 无害环境管理表2报告了一种基于方向的自动插槽分配变式,该变式与报告的基于元数据的插槽的精确度相匹配,平均为3次。

blocks.en: After the SwinV2 backbone, the architecture performs multi-view fusion, as shown in Figure 3 . Each available view is processed independently by a shared SwinV2-base image encoder, producing one feature vector per view. These per-view features are treated as a token sequence and fused using a lightweight transformer [ 26 ] : we prepend a learned fusion token and add learned positional embeddings so that the fusion module can exploit the consistent view ordering. After two transformer layers, the output is used as a single global representation of the crash case.
blocks.zh: SwinV2主干后,该架构进行多视多聚,如图3所显示. 每个可用视图由共享的SwinV2基图像编码器独立处理,每个视图产生一个特征矢量. 这些per-view特性被作为符号序列对待,并使用轻量级变压器[26]进行熔接:我们预置了已学习的聚变符并添加已学习到的位置嵌入,使聚变模块能够利用一致的取景顺序. 经过两个变压器层后,输出被作为坠机案的单一全球代表.

blocks.en: On top of the fused embedding, we study two decoder configurations. In the single-task setting, the fused representation is passed to a single multilayer perceptron (MLP) prediction head that outputs one target at a time. In the multi-task setting, the backbone and fusion module remain shared, but the fused representation is first mapped through a shared pre-head into a common hidden space and then passed to multiple task-specific heads. Thus, the two settings share the same case representation, image backbone, and fusion module, while differing in output heads and in training strategy.
blocks.zh: 在引信嵌入器上,我们研究两个解码器配置. 在单一任务设置中,被引信的表示被传递到一个单一多层受体(MLP)的预测头上,一次输出一个目标. 在多任务设定中,主干和聚变模块仍然共享,但被熔化的表示首先通过共享前头被映射出一个共同的隐藏空间,再被传递给多个任务特定头. 因此,这两种设置共用相同的案例说明、图像主干和聚变模块,而产出头和培训战略则有所不同。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Multi-view crash descriptor architecture: a shared SwinV2 encodes nine ordered views, a lightweight fusion transformer aggregates them into a case embedding, and a decoder predicts CDC descriptors and Δ ​ V \Delta V .
blocks.zh: 图3 多视图崩溃描述器架构:一个共享的SwinV2编码了9个已订购的视图,一个轻量级的聚变变器将它们聚合成一个外壳嵌入,一个解码器预测CDC描述器和QQ V\Delta V.

blocks.en: 4.1 Preprocessing and Data Challenges
blocks.zh: 4.1 预处理和数据挑战

blocks.en: Real-world crash photo sets contain irrelevant close-ups, missing viewpoints, incomplete target annotations, and strongly imbalanced labels. We address these issues through vehicle and wheel filtering, fixed 9-slot view construction, view-drop augmentation, masked losses for missing labels, and imbalance-aware sampling. Full preprocessing, curation, and missing-label details are provided in the ESM, Section 2.
blocks.zh: Real-world crash相片集包含不相干特写,缺少观点,目标说明不完整,标签严重失衡. 我们通过车辆和轮子过滤、固定的9相距视图建造、视图投放增强、缺失标签的隐蔽损失和对不平衡的认识取样来解决这些问题。 无害环境管理第2节提供了完整的预处理、校正和缺失标签细节。

blocks.en: The targets differ substantially in visual observability. Impact plane and principal direction of force are often supported by the visible damage layout, whereas crush-zone descriptors and deformation extent may depend on subtle, occluded, or missing views. Δ ​ V \Delta V is the least directly observable target because it is a reconstructed kinematic quantity inferred only indirectly from post-crash appearance. Since labels are case-level and not localized to image regions, the model must identify useful evidence across heterogeneous multi-view inputs, which motivates joint training across related descriptors.
blocks.zh: 目标在视觉可观察性方面差别很大。 撞击平面和主要武力方向往往得到可见的破坏布局的支持,而粉碎区描述符和变形程度则可能取决于微妙的,被围住的或缺失的视角. V\Delta V是最不直接观察到的目标,因为它是一个重建的动能量,只是从碰撞后外观中间接推断出来的. 由于标签是案例级的,不是地方化的图像区域,该模型必须确定各种多视图投入的有用证据,这促使相关描述者进行联合培训。

blocks.en: 4.2 Method Setup
blocks.zh: 4.2 方法设置

blocks.en: Preliminary ablations over backbones and view-fusion strategies favored independently encoded SwinV2 view tokens fused with a lightweight transformer. Details are reported in the ESM, Section 1. With this case representation fixed, the main study compares two practical training regimes: single-task models, where one descriptor is learned per model instance, and a joint-training model, where the shared trunk is trained with multiple task-specific heads.
blocks.zh: 骨干上的初步分解和取景策略倾向于独立地编码了SwinV2取景符并配有轻量级变压器. 详情见无害环境管理第1节。 随着这个案例表述的固定,主要研究比较了两个实用培训制度:单一任务模式,每个模型学习一个描述符;联合培训模式,共享的干线由多个任务特定负责人培训.

blocks.en: 4.3 Descriptor Targets and Task Formulations
blocks.zh: 4.3 目标和任务拟订

blocks.en: The CDC principal direction of force (DoF) is modeled as a 12-class circular prediction problem. Since neighboring clock positions represent small angular deviations and opposite positions large ones, we replace one-hot labels with Gaussian-smoothed target distributions over circular distance and minimize KL divergence to the model log-probabilities. At evaluation, the predicted class is converted to an angle and scored by mean absolute angular error under minimal circular distance. We also tested sin ⁡ ( θ ) , cos ⁡ ( θ ) \sin(\theta),\cos(\theta) regression, but circular classification performed better in preliminary experiments; see the ESM, Section 1.

blocks.en: For non-circular CDC descriptors, impact plane, damage distribution, longitudinal/lateral zone, and vertical/lateral zone, we use cross-entropy loss with the same imbalance-aware sampling scheme. We report accuracy and macro-F1, the latter reflecting performance on underrepresented classes. Deformation extent (01–09) is ordinal, so we train it as 9-way classification with label smoothing and report exact accuracy, Acc@ ± 1 \pm 1 for predictions within one neighboring grade, and MAE in bin units to capture near-miss errors.

blocks.en: 4.4 Single-task
blocks.zh: 4.4 单一任务

blocks.en: We use single-task training as a reference setting in which one descriptor is learned per model instance. All single-task models share the same case representation, image backbone, and fusion module, while the final prediction head is task-specific. This setup provides per-target reference results under a common input pipeline. Class imbalance is handled through task-specific sampling, and samples without the required target are skipped for that task. Full sampling and optimization details are provided in the ESM, Section 3.
blocks.zh: 我们使用单一任务培训作为参考,每个示范实例学习一个描述符。 所有单一任务模型都拥有相同的大小写,图像主干和聚变模块,而最终的预测头则是任务特有. 这一设置在共同投入管道下提供每个目标参考结果。 分类不平衡是通过针对特定任务的取样处理的,没有规定目标的样品会被跳过。 无害环境管理第3节提供了全面的取样和优化细节。

blocks.en: 4.5 Multi-task
blocks.zh: 4.5 多任务

blocks.en: Several labels describe overlapping aspects of the same physical event, so joint training is a natural practical baseline: a single shared representation can support all descriptor heads and may encourage the model to encode global crash-configuration cues. We therefore compare independent single-task reference models with a joint-training configuration in which the SwinV2 backbone and fusion module are shared across targets. This comparison is intended to evaluate two practical training regimes under the same multi-view input protocol, not to isolate multi-task supervision as the only changing factor.
blocks.zh: 多个标签描述了同一物理事件的重叠方面,因此联合训练是一个自然而然的实用基准:单一共享的表示可以支持所有描述头并可能鼓励模型编码出全球相撞配置提示. 因此,我们将独立的单一任务参考模式与联合培训配置进行比较,在联合培训配置中,SwinV2主干和聚变模块在各目标之间共享。 这种比较旨在评价同一多视图输入协议下的两个实用培训制度,而不是孤立多任务监督作为唯一的变化因素.

blocks.en: In the joint-training configuration, the fused case embedding is first passed through a shared pre-head MLP and then routed to task-specific heads, as shown in Figure 3 . Missing labels are handled through task-specific loss masking, so each sample contributes only to the heads with valid annotations. Class imbalance is handled with a shared task-aware sampling policy, and loss balancing is stabilized with GradNorm and Dynamic Weight Averaging during training.
blocks.zh: 如图3所示,在联合训练配置中,被引信的外壳嵌入首先通过一个共享的前头 MLP 传递,然后通向特定任务头. 缺失的标签是通过任务特定损失掩码处理的,因此每个样本只向头部贡献有有效说明. 班级不平衡采用共同的任务意识抽样政策处理,在培训期间,损失平衡与GradNorm和动态加权平衡得到稳定。

blocks.en: Because this configuration differs from the single-task reference not only in joint supervision but also in initialization, loss balancing, sampling, and optimization schedule, the comparison should be interpreted as a comparison between selected single-task and joint-training setups under a common input representation, not as a perfectly matched ablation of multi-task supervision alone. Full training details and hyperparameters are provided in the ESM, Section 3 and Table 3.
blocks.zh: 由于这种配置不仅在联合监管中,而且在初始化,损失平衡,取样和优化时间表中都与单任务参考不同,因此比较应被解释为在共同投入代表下对所选单任务和联合培训设置进行比较,而不是完全匹配的单多任务监督. 无害环境管理第3节和表3提供了完整的培训细节和超参数。

blocks.zh: 5 实验和结果

blocks.en: This section reports the main experimental results. All models were trained on a single GPU (NVIDIA A40/L40S, depending on the run). The target definitions are summarized in Table 1 .

blocks.en: Unless stated otherwise, test results are reported at validation-selected checkpoints: best per head for single-task training and best joint objective for joint training. Because the reported single-task and joint-training models use different selected training configurations, summarized in the ESM, Table 3, the comparison should be read as an empirical comparison between two practical training regimes rather than as an isolated ablation of multi-task supervision. Accordingly, gains from the joint model reflect the selected joint-training pipeline as a whole, including shared supervision, initialization, sampling, and loss balancing.
blocks.zh: 除非另有说明,在选定的验证检查站报告测试结果:单任务培训的每个负责人最好,联合培训的最佳共同目标。 由于所报告的单一任务和联合培训模式采用了无害环境管理表3所概括的不同选定培训配置,因此比较应理解为两个实际培训制度之间的实证比较,而不是孤立地削弱多任务监督。 因此,联合模式的收益反映了选定的联合培训管道整体,包括共享监督、初始化、取样和损失平衡。

blocks.en: 5.1 Single-task
blocks.zh: 5.1 单一任务

blocks.en: We first report single-task baselines, where each descriptor is learned by an independent model using the same SwinV2 encoder and fusion transformer (Section 4 ). Test performance is reported at validation-selected checkpoints, and Table 2 summarizes the results.
blocks.zh: 我们首先报告单任务基线,每个描述器由一个使用同一种SwinV2编码器和聚变器的独立模型学习(第4节)。 测试业绩在选定的验证检查站报告,表2总结了结果。

blocks.en: The single-task baselines show a clear split between visually well-supported descriptors and targets limited by weak evidence or label imbalance. Impact plane and DoF are learned well, indicating that the model can recover coarse impact geometry from post-crash views. The longitudinal/lateral zone also shows usable signal, suggesting that the model often localizes the main crush region along the vehicle length. In contrast, vertical/lateral zone and damage distribution are more strongly affected by long-tailed labels, with frequent classes dominating performance. Deformation extent is difficult to predict exactly, but near-miss agreement is substantially higher under Acc@ ± 1 \pm 1 , consistent with its graded severity interpretation. For Δ ​ V \Delta V , the single-task model reaches MAE of 8.04 km/h for the longitudinal component and 5.31 km/h for the lateral component on the labeled subset, showing that visual evidence contains a measurable, though incomplete, signal for reconstructed kinematic quantities.
blocks.zh: 单一任务基线显示,视觉上支持良好的描述符和受到薄弱证据或标签不平衡限制的目标之间有明显的分化. 撞击平面和DoF学得好,表明模型可以从碰撞后视图中恢复粗糙的撞击几何. 纵向/边区也显示可用信号,表明该型号常会将车身长度上的主要粉碎区域定位. 相形之下,垂直/边区和损害分布受到长尾标签的影响更强烈,频繁的分类占据了性能. 变形程度难以准确预测,但在Acc@±1\pm 1下,接近误差的协议要高得多,符合其分级的严重程度解释. 对于QQ V\Delta V,单任务型号达到:纵向元件的MAE为8.04km/h,被标注子集的横向元件为5.31km/h,显示视觉证据包含一个可测量的,虽然不完整的,但重建动量的信号.

blocks.en: 5.2 Multi-task
blocks.zh: 5.2 多任务

blocks.en: We next report the joint model, which predicts all crash descriptors jointly using a shared SwinV2 encoder and fusion transformer with task-specific heads (Section 4.5 ). The same evaluation protocol is used as for the single-task baselines, with the checkpoint selected by the validation joint objective. Table 2 compares both regimes.
blocks.zh: 我们下次报告联合模型,该模型将使用共用的SwinV2编码器和带有特定任务头的聚变器(第4.5节)联合预测所有坠机描述符。 与单一任务基线使用相同的评价协议,由验证联合目标选择检查站。 表2比较了这两个制度。

Δ \Delta denotes the absolute change from the selected single-task model to the selected joint-training model, and Rel. blocks.en: The selected joint-training pipeline improves several context-dependent targets, with the largest gain on DoF angular error ( 20.1 ∘ → 14.05 ∘ 20.1^{\circ}\rightarrow 14.05^{\circ} ) and consistent improvements for deformation extent and both Δ ​ V \Delta V components. These results suggest that shared training can be useful in this setting, but the evidence should be interpreted at the pipeline level rather than as a clean causal estimate of multi-task supervision alone. The joint model differs from the single-task references in initialization, sampling, loss balancing, and optimization schedule, all of which may contribute to the observed changes.
blocks.zh: 选定的联合训练管道改进了几个取决于具体情况的目标,在DoF角误差(20.1 ∘ → → 14.05 ∘ 20.1 ^{\ Circ}\ Rightarrow 14.05 ^{\ Circ} } })上获得的最大收益,并持续地改进了变形程度和 Δ V \ Delta V 组件. 这些结果表明,在这一背景下,共享培训可能有用,但证据应被解释为管道层面的证据,而不是仅仅作为对多任务监督的清洁因果估计。 联合模型在初始化、取样、损失平衡和优化时间表方面与单任务参考不同,所有这些都可能有助于观察到的变化。

blocks.en: The gains are also not uniform. Impact-plane accuracy changes only marginally, long./lat. zone macro-F1 decreases, and damage-distribution accuracy drops modestly. These failures are informative: they indicate that a single shared sampler and loss-balancing scheme may under-serve targets with different long-tail structure compared with task-specific single-task training. Thus, the joint model is best viewed as a compact reference pipeline with favorable aggregate behavior, not as uniformly superior across all descriptors. Detailed cross-paper reference points are provided in the ESM, Section 4.
blocks.zh: 所得也并不一致. 撞击平面精度变化不大,长./低.区宏-F1下降,损害分布精度下降幅度不大。 这些失败提供了信息:它们表明,与针对特定任务的单一任务培训相比,单一的共享采样器和损失平衡方案可能保留了不同长尾结构的目标。 因此,联合模型最好被看作是一个具有有利整体行为的紧凑的参考管道,而不是在所有描述者中具有统一的优越性。 详细的跨文件参考要点载于无害环境管理第4节。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We presented a CISS-based evaluation protocol for crash descriptor estimation from real-world, naturally incomplete multi-view post-crash photo sets. Using a unified SwinV2 and transformer-fusion architecture, we showed that post-crash imagery contains usable signal for recovering several CDC-derived deformation descriptors together with reconstructed longitudinal and lateral Δ ​ V \Delta V components. Under the selected training configurations used in this study, the integrated joint-training pipeline improved several targets, most notably reducing DoF angular error by 30.1% (from 20.1 ∘ 20.1^{\circ} to 14.05 ∘ 14.05^{\circ} ), while also improving deformation extent and both Δ ​ V \Delta V components. These results should be interpreted as practical reference performance for image-based crash-mechanics estimation, not as a replacement for reconstruction or EDR-based analysis. At the same time, some descriptors remained limited by weak observability and strong class imbalance, highlighting that image-based crash understanding is feasible but still incomplete in this real-world setting. Overall, these results support post-crash imagery as a practical complementary source of crash-mechanics information and provide a reference point for future multimodal models that combine images with structured crash metadata.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了基于CISS的评估协议,用于从现实世界、自然不完整的多视图碰撞后相片中进行崩溃描述估计。 使用统一的SwinV2和变压器-聚变结构,我们显示相撞后图像包含可用信号来回收由CDC衍生出的若干变形符,并有被重建的纵向和横向的QQ V\Delta V组件. 根据本研究中采用的选定培训配置,综合联合培训管道改进了几个目标,最显著的是将DoF角误差减少30.1%(从20.1%-20.1-circ})到14.05-14.05-circ},同时也提高了变形程度并同时改进了-V-Delta V组件. 这些结果应被解释为基于图像的相撞力学估计的实际参考性能,而不是重建或基于东德的分析的取而代之. 同时,一些描述词仍然受到弱的可观察性和强烈的阶级不平衡的限制,强调基于图像的崩溃理解是可行的,但在这种现实世界环境中仍然不完整. 总的来说,这些结果支持了碰撞后图像作为碰撞机械信息的实际补充来源,并为未来将图像与结构化的崩溃元数据相结合的多模式模型提供了一个参考点.

blocks.en: A natural next step is multimodal crash understanding that combines photo evidence with structured crash metadata commonly used in severity modeling, including vehicle, occupant, roadway, and environmental factors. Such structured fields could improve robustness, especially for weakly observable descriptors and for Δ ​ V \Delta V , where labels are noisy and incomplete. Architecturally, this suggests a multimodal design that (i) encodes images into a fused case embedding, (ii) embeds structured fields via a lightweight MLP or transformer, and (iii) fuses both modalities jointly. Another important direction is the construction of curated subsets with improved class balance, especially for rare crash descriptors that are difficult to assess reliably in the current long-tailed setting.
blocks.zh: 下一个自然步骤是多模式相撞理解,将照片证据与严重性模型制作中常用的结构相撞元数据相结合,包括车辆、占用者、道路和环境因素。 这种结构化的字段可以提高稳健性,特别是对于弱可观测的描述词和QQ V\Delta V来说,标签响亮而不完整。 从结构上讲,这建议了一种多式联运设计,即(一) 将图像编码成一个装有引信的外壳嵌入,(二) 通过轻量级MLP或变压器嵌入结构化场,(三) 联合引信两种模式。 另一个重要方向是构建有改善班级平衡的编译子集,特别是对于在目前长尾布局下难以可靠评估的稀有坠机描述.

blocks.en: From Wrecks to Wisdom: Recovering Crash Mechanics from Real-World Multi-View Photos Supplementary Material
blocks.zh: 从"沉船"到"智慧":从"真实世界多维相片"中找回"崩溃机械"

blocks.en: 1 Preliminary Experiments on Direction of Force (CDC Clock)
blocks.zh: 1 力量方向的初步实验(CDC Clock)

blocks.en: We ran preliminary experiments on the CDC 12-bin direction-of-force (DoF, clock) descriptor because it provides one of the clearest visual signals in post-crash photo sets and therefore served as a practical proxy for selecting the backbone and multi-view aggregation design. These experiments are intended as model selection evidence for the input and fusion pipeline.
blocks.zh: 我们初步试验了CDC 12 Bin 向力(DoF, clock)描述器,因为它提供了相机后最清晰的视觉信号之一,因此成为选择骨干和多视图聚合设计的实际代用. 这些实验旨在作为输入和聚变管道的模型选择证据。

blocks.en: We compared several backbones and multi-view aggregation strategies, and evaluated three practical ways of converting a crash case into a photo-set input: (i) sampling a random subset of K K images (with replication or permutation), (ii) concatenating all images along the channel dimension, and (iii) mapping photos into fixed ordered view slots with padding for missing viewpoints.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了几个主干线和多视图聚合策略,评价了将相撞案转换为相片集输入的三种实际方法:(一) 抽样随机的K图像子集(带有复制或穿透),(二) 沿通道维度将所有图像相接,(三) 将相片映射到固定的定点视图插槽中,为缺失的视点进行粘接.

blocks.en: Across these experiments, tested CNN-style backbones (EfficientNet-B4 and InternImage-T) did not make sustained progress: training curves oscillated and validation angular error plateaued early. A modest improvement was observed when InternImage-T consumed all views jointly via channel concatenation, but performance still saturated quickly.
blocks.zh: 在这些试验中,经过测试的CNN式主干线(EfficentNet-B4和InternImage-T)没有取得持续进展:培训曲线摇摆不定,验证角误差提前得到固定。 当InternImage-T通过信道接合共同消耗了所有视图时,观察到了适度的改进,但性能仍然很快饱和.

blocks.en: Transformer backbones adapted better to the task. With SwinV2-base, mean pooling provided a small gain, concatenation of per-view tokens improved further, and a dedicated token-fusion transformer operating on fixed ordered views produced the most stable learning behavior and the lowest validation error (about 20 ∘ 20^{\circ} AngErr). This motivated the final design used in the main paper.
blocks.zh: 变形骨干更能适应任务. 与SwinV2-base,即集成提供了小收益,将每个视图的活字符号凝聚得到进一步的改进,在固定定点视图上运行的专用活字聚变器产生了最稳定的学习行为和最低的验证错误(约20 ∘ 20^{\ Circ} AngErr). 这推动了主要论文中使用的最后设计。

blocks.en: 1.1 Per-Setup Description (P1-P6)
blocks.zh: 1.1 每组说明(P1-P6)

blocks.en: Table 1 summarizes the configurations and we describe each setup referenced by its P-code.
blocks.zh: 表1汇总了各种配置,我们介绍每个配置,并按其P-代码参考。

blocks.en: P1 uses an EfficientNet-B4 encoder shared across views. Each crash case is represented by a random subset of K K available images; when fewer than K K views are present, images are replicated to keep a fixed view count (Rand K K , rep). View features are fused by simple concatenation (Concat.), and the DoF target is trained via circular regression by predicting ( sin ⁡ θ , cos ⁡ θ ) (\sin\theta,\cos\theta) with an MSE loss. In practice, this configuration did not learn reliably: training was unstable and validation error oscillated around a plateau.
blocks.zh: P1使用跨视图共享的高效Net-B4编码器. 每个崩溃大小写由K可用图像的随机子集来代表;当存在不到K视图时,图像被复制以保持固定的视图计数(Rand K K, represent). 视图特性由简单的接合(Concat.)来接合而来,DoF目标通过循环回归通过预测(sin QQ, cos QQ)(\sin\theta,\cos\theta)与MSE损失来训练. 在实践中,这种配置没有可靠地学习:训练不稳定,验证错误在高地上徘徊.

blocks.en: P2 evaluates InternImage-T with the same randomized view construction (Rand K K , rep). Per-view features are concatenated (Concat.) and the DoF head is trained as 12-way circular classification using Gaussian-smoothed targets over circular distance with KL divergence (Circ-smooth KL). Similar to P1, this per-view processing + concat setup showed limited learning progress and quickly saturated.
blocks.zh: P2评价同为随机取景构造的InternImage-T(Rand K K, represent). per-view的特征被收缩了(Concat.),DoF头被训练为12道循环分级,使用高斯-吸附目标与有KL相差的循环相距(Circ-smooth KL). 与P1类似,这种per-view处理+concat设置显示学习进展有限并快速饱和.

blocks.en: P3 changes only the input representation: instead of encoding views independently, images are stacked along the channel dimension and fed into InternImage-T in a single pass, so no explicit fusion module is needed. This produced a measurable but modest improvement over P2. However, validation error still plateaued relatively early, suggesting that the model benefited from joint low-level processing but remained limited in multi-view reasoning.
blocks.zh: P3只更改了输入表达式:不独立地编码视图,而是将图像沿通道维度堆放并用一通通道输入InternImage-T,因此不需要明确的聚变模块. 这比P2有了可衡量而微小的改进。 然而,验证误差相对来说还比较早被固定,这表明该模型得益于联合低级处理,但在多视图推理方面仍然有限.

blocks.en: P4 uses a SwinV2-base backbone, which processes each view as a token sequence. Views are sampled as a random subset with permutation (Rand K K , perm), and fused by mean pooling over embeddings. The head predicts ( sin ⁡ θ , cos ⁡ θ ) (\sin\theta,\cos\theta) with an MSE loss. This configuration learned more consistently than CNN-style baselines, but improvements remained modest.
blocks.zh: P4使用SwinV2基干线,将每个视图作为符号序列处理. 视图作为随机子集进行抽取,并带有穿插(Rand K K, perm),并被平均集合于嵌入上相接. 头部预言(罪 ⁡ θ θ , , ⁡ s\ s\ sin sin sin ta sin sin sta sta sta sta sta sta sta sta sta sta sta sta) 有MSE损失. 这种配置比有线电视新闻网式的基线更为一致,但改进程度仍然不大。

blocks.en: P5 keeps the SwinV2-base backbone but uses random- K K sampling with replication when fewer than K K views are available, and fuses the resulting view features by concatenation rather than mean pooling. This configuration achieved lower angular error than P4, suggesting that preserving per-view identity in the fused representation was beneficial, although the comparison also reflects the change in view construction.
blocks.zh: P5保留了SwinV2基干线,但在可获得的KK视图少于KK时使用随机-K K采样并进行复制,并用接合而不是表示集合来将由此产生的取景特征引信. 这种配置比P4实现了更低的角误差,表明在被引信的表示中保留每个视图的身份是有益的,尽管比较也反映了视图构造的变化.

blocks.en: P6 aligns with the final design direction: images are mapped into a fixed ordered 9-slot representation (Fixed-9), and missing canonical viewpoints are filled by padding. Per-view tokens are fused by a dedicated transformer-based fusion module (Transf.fuse), and the DoF head uses circularly smoothed classification with KL divergence (Circ-smooth KL). This setup produced the most stable learning behavior and reached the lowest validation error in these experiments ( 21.8 ∘ 21.8^{\circ} AngErr), motivating its use in the main model. Note that these numbers reflect results from the preliminary ablation study training runs, therefore the 21.8 ∘ 21.8^{\circ} is not equal to our best single-task DoF result.
blocks.zh: P6与最终设计方向相匹配:图像被映射成一个固定的定点的9相间表示(Fixed-9),而缺失的犬形观点则被被贴上. per-view sorders由专用的以变压器为主的聚变模块(Transf.fuse)接通而成,DoF头使用循环平滑分出KL分出(Circ-smooth KL)的分类. 这种设置产生了最稳定的学习行为,并达到了这些实验中最低的验证错误(21.8 ∘ 21.8 ^{\ Circ} AngErr),激发了它在主模型中的使用. 请注意,这些数字反映了初步研究培训的结果,因此,21.8 ∘ 21.8 ^{\circ}不等于我们最好的单一任务研究的结果。

blocks.en: These ablations represent a compact subset of the exploratory experiments conducted during model development and are included because they capture the main design decisions that shaped the final model. Additional runs were performed, but they did not provide sufficiently distinct insights to justify separate inclusion here.
blocks.zh: 这些活化法是模型开发过程中进行的探索性实验的一个紧凑的子集,之所以列入这些实验,是因为它们抓住了决定最终模型的主要设计决定。 进行了更多的审查,但是这些审查没有提供足够独特的见解,因而没有理由在此单独列入。

blocks.en: 2 Dataset Curation, Preprocessing, and Evaluation Details
blocks.zh: 2 数据集校正、预处理和评价细节

blocks.en: This section provides supplementary implementation details for preprocessing and dataset curation, example filtering outcomes, case construction, missing-label handling, view-drop augmentation, and checkpoint selection. These details support the main experimental protocol but are not essential for understanding the core architecture or main results.
blocks.zh: 本节提供预处理和数据集设置、实例过滤结果、案例构建、缺失标签处理、视图投放增强和检查站选择的补充实施细节。 这些细节支持了主要的实验协议,但对理解核心架构或主要结果并不重要.

blocks.en: 2.1 Crash Case Acquisition and Curation Pipeline
blocks.zh: 2.1 克拉舍案购置和治理管道

blocks.en: Figure 1 summarizes the acquisition and curation pipeline used to construct the benchmark. We first collected publicly available crash investigation cases from the NHTSA CISS database, including case metadata, case images, and associated documents.
blocks.zh: 图1汇总了用于构建基准的购置和保管管道。 我们首先从NHTSA CISS数据库中收集了公开的坠机调查案件,包括案件元数据,案件图像和相关文件.

blocks.en: We then applied a data-cleaning stage to remove unusable cases, including entries with empty metadata, repeated or multiply crashed cases, and cases missing essential images. After this initial cleanup, we performed metadata-based image filtering to retain crash-relevant exterior vehicle views and discard visually uninformative categories.
blocks.zh: 然后,我们采用了一个数据清理阶段来删除无法使用的案例,包括空元数据条目、多发或多发坠毁的案例以及缺少基本图像的案例。 在这次初步清理后,我们进行了基于元数据的图像过滤,以保留与相撞有关的外出车辆视图并丢弃视效不信息分类。

blocks.en: The remaining candidate images were passed through a YOLOv8s vehicle-filtering stage, where we kept only images containing a sufficiently large detected vehicle. Finally, a dedicated RetinaNet-based wheel detector removed wheel-dominant close-up images that provide limited information about global crash deformation context. The resulting curated image sets were used for the downstream case construction and experiments reported in this work.
blocks.zh: 其余的候选图像是通过YOLOv8s车辆过滤阶段传送的,我们只保存了含有足够大被探测到的车辆的图像。 最后,一个基于RetinaNet的专用轮子探测器去除了轮子占上风的特写图像,这些图像提供了有限的全球相撞变形背景信息. 所制作的图集用于下游案例的构造和本作中报告的实验。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of the crash case acquisition and curation pipeline. Starting from publicly available NHTSA CISS cases, we applied data cleaning, metadata-based image filtering, YOLOv8s vehicle filtering, and a dedicated RetinaNet-based wheel-detector filtering stage to obtain the final curated crash-image sets used in this study.
blocks.zh: 图1:坠机案件购置和保管管道概况。 从公开的NHTSA CISS案例开始,我们应用了数据清理,基于元数据的图像过滤,YOLOv8s车辆过滤,以及一个基于RetinaNet的专用轮检测器过滤阶段,以获得本研究中使用的最终被校正的相机相机.

blocks.en: 2.2 Preprocessing and Data Challenges
blocks.zh: 2.2 预处理和数据挑战

blocks.en: Given a case with post-crash images and annotations, we address four practical issues before training: irrelevant close-ups, missing viewpoints, missing target values, and strong class imbalance.
blocks.zh: 鉴于一个有后崩溃图像和说明的案例,我们在培训前要处理四个实际问题:无关紧要的特写,缺失的观点,缺失的目标值,以及强烈的阶级不平衡.

blocks.en: CISS vehicle photos sometimes include close-up images that carry little information about case-level deformation. A frequent example is a wheel close-up that is technically associated with a vehicle viewpoint but contributes little to global crash reasoning. To reduce this noise, we train a dedicated wheel detector model based on the RetinaNet [ 11 ] architecture on the CAWDEC [ 19 ] dataset and apply it as a preprocessing filter to remove images dominated by wheels. Representative removed examples are shown in Figure 2 .
blocks.zh: CISS车辆相片有时会包含特写相片,这些相片很少包含关于案例级变形的信息. 一个常见的例子就是车轮特写,在技术上与车辆观点有关,但对全球坠机推理作用不大。 为了减少这种噪音,我们根据CAWDEC [19] 数据集上的RetinaNet[11]架构,训练出专用的轮子探测器模型,并将其作为预处理过滤器来去除以轮子为主的图像. 已删除的代表实例见图2。

blocks.en: Most cases are missing one or more canonical viewpoints, so the corresponding slots remain empty. During training, we additionally apply random view-drop augmentation to improve robustness to incomplete evidence. At inference, the model receives only the available post-crash images.
blocks.zh: 大部分案件都缺少了一个或多个犬形观点,因此相应的插槽仍然为空. 在训练期间,我们额外采用随机取景增强法,以提高对不完整证据的坚固性. 推断出,该模型只接收可用的后碰撞图像.

blocks.en: Some cases also lack target values, most commonly Δ ​ V \Delta V . In single-task training, such samples are skipped for the relevant head. In multi-task training, losses are masked per head so that a sample contributes only to the targets with valid annotations, preserving partially annotated cases. Finally, because the CDC-derived targets are strongly imbalanced, we handle long-tail structure during sampling and report macro-F1 in addition to accuracy.
blocks.zh: 一些案例也缺乏目标值,最常见的是QQ V\Delta V. 在单一任务培训中,这些样本被跳过给相关负责人。 在多任务训练中,每个头部的损失被遮住,这样样本只为目标提供有效说明,保留部分附加说明的案例. 最后,由于疾控中心衍生出的目标严重不平衡,我们在取样时处理长尾结构,除了准确性外,还报告宏观-F1.

blocks.en: 2.3 Wheel-Detector Filtering Details
blocks.zh: 2.3 轮式探测器过滤细节

blocks.en: To reduce noise from close-up images that do not capture the global deformation pattern, we trained a dedicated wheel detector on the CAWDEC dataset [ 19 ] . The detector was used only as a preprocessing filter: images dominated by wheels were removed before case-level view construction. This was necessary because such close-ups are not identifiable from the available CISS metadata alone, even though they carry little information about crash-level deformation.
blocks.zh: 为了减少不捕捉到全球变形图案的特写图像产生的噪音,我们在CAWDEC数据集上训练了一台专用轮子探测器[19]. 探测器仅用作预处理过滤器:以轮子为主的图像被移除后再进行大小写级视图构建. 这样做是必要的,因为仅从现有的CISS元数据无法识别这种特写,尽管这些特写几乎没有关于崩溃级变形的信息。

blocks.en: In the preprocessing pipeline, the detector was applied to candidate vehicle images prior to slot assignment. Images identified as wheel-dominated were excluded from further processing, while ordinary side views that still contained broader crash evidence were retained. Overall, this step reduced visually uninformative close-ups while preserving images relevant to case-level deformation reasoning.
blocks.zh: 在预处理管道中,检测器在分配档位前被应用到候选车辆图像上. 被确定为以轮为主的图像被排除于进一步处理之外,而仍然包含更广泛的坠机证据的普通侧面观点被保留. 总的来说,这一步骤减少了视觉上非信息化的特写,同时保留了与案例一级变形推理相关的图像.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Representative examples removed by the wheel-filtering step. The discarded images are dominated by close-up wheel views and contain limited information about global crash deformation.
blocks.zh: 图 2:被取出轮滤步骤去掉的代表性例子. 被丢弃的图像以特写轮视图为主,并包含关于全球相撞变形的有限信息.

blocks.en: 2.4 9-Slot Construction
blocks.zh: 2.4 9-平地建造

blocks.en: Each crash case was mapped into a fixed 9-slot representation corresponding to the canonical viewpoints used throughout the study: front, rear, right, left, front-right, front-left, rear-right, rear-left, and top. When a viewpoint was unavailable, the corresponding slot was left empty and filled by padding. This representation preserves viewpoint identity across cases and allows the fusion module to associate tokens with consistent semantic positions.
blocks.zh: 每个坠机案被映射成一个固定的9相间代表,与整个研究中使用的克恩派观点相对应:前,后,右,左,前右,后左和上. 无法查看时, 相应的空位会被空出, 并用贴上填入 。 这种表达方式保留了不同情况下的观点特性,使聚变模块能够将符号与一致的语义位置联系起来。

blocks.en: If multiple images were available for the same canonical slot, the preprocessing pipeline selected one representative image at random. The same ordered slot representation was used during both training and evaluation. To make this step reproducible, the random choice is fixed by the preprocessing seed before model training, so validation and test cases use deterministic slot assignments. Since the slot assignment uses viewpoint metadata, this setup should be understood as image-based prediction with view organization supported by metadata, not as fully unconstrained image-set learning. For datasets without viewpoint metadata, we also evaluate automatic slot assignment using a vehicle orientation estimator trained from the Car Full View Dataset [ 1 ] . Table 2 compares this automatic variant with the metadata-based slot assignment used in the main benchmark.
blocks.zh: 如果有多个图像可供同一条条线槽使用,预处理管道会随机选择一个代表性图像. 在培训和评价期间,也采用了同样的定档表示。 为了使这一步骤可以再生,随机选择在模型训练前由预处理种子固定,因此验证和测试案例使用定档分配. 由于插槽任务使用视角元数据,这种设置应被理解为基于图像的预测,其视图组织由元数据支持,而不是完全不受约束的图像集学习. 对于没有视角元数据的数据集,我们也使用汽车全景数据集训练的车辆定向估计器来评价自动槽分配. [1]. 表2将这一自动变体与主要基准中使用的基于元数据的时间档分配进行比较。

blocks.en: Table 2: Effect of view-slot construction on DoF prediction. Metadata slots use CISS viewpoint labels and are used in the main experiments to isolate crash-descriptor learning from viewpoint-estimation noise. Auto-orientation slots use an image-based vehicle-orientation estimator trained from the Car Full View Dataset [ 1 ] to assign views to the fixed 9-slot representation. Results are averaged over three runs using the same DoF model and evaluation protocol.
blocks.zh: 表2:取景地构造对DoF预测的影响. 元数据槽使用 CISS 视角标签,并在主要实验中被用来隔离崩溃描述器从视角-估计噪声中学习. 自动定向插槽使用从"汽车全景数据集"[1]训练出来的基于图像的车辆定向估计器,为固定的"9相槽"表示分配视图. 使用同样的DOF模式和评价协议,平均在三次运行中得出结果。

blocks.en: Both fixed-slot variants substantially reduce DoF angular error compared with unordered random view construction. Averaged over three runs, the auto-orientation result matches the metadata-slot result at the reported precision, suggesting that the gain comes mainly from organizing views into consistent canonical slots. For DoF prediction, this indicates that predicted vehicle orientation can replace viewpoint metadata for this part of the pipeline.
blocks.zh: 与无序随机视图构建相比,两个固定相位变量都大幅降低了DoF角错. 平均在三跑中,自动定向结果与报告的精确度相匹配,表明收益主要来自将观点组织成一致的条块。 就DoF预测而言,这表明,预测的车辆取向可以取代管道这一部分的视图元数据。

blocks.en: 2.5 View-Drop Augmentation and Missing Labels
blocks.zh: 2.5 视图-作物增强和缺失标签

blocks.en: During training, we randomly dropped between 0 and 6 available views per case to improve robustness to incomplete evidence. This augmentation exposes the model to varying levels of view availability during training. At inference, no views are synthetically dropped and the model receives only the available post-crash images.
blocks.zh: 在训练期间,我们随机放弃了每个案件0至6个现有观点,以提高证据的可靠性,使其不完全。 这种增强使该模式在培训期间获得不同程度的视野。 推论中,没有任何视图被合成地抛出,模型只接收到可用的后碰撞图像.

blocks.en: Missing target labels were handled differently in the two regimes. In single-task training, samples without the required target were skipped for that task. In multi-task training, losses were masked per head so that a sample contributed only to the targets with valid annotations.
blocks.zh: 两种制度对缺失的目标标签的处理不同。 在单一任务培训中,没有规定目标的样本被跳过。 在多任务训练中,每个头部的损失被遮住,这样一个样本只为目标贡献了有效的说明.

blocks.en: 3 Training and Optimization Details
blocks.zh: 3 培训和优化细节

blocks.en: This section provides the training and sampling details used for the single-task and multi-task configurations reported in the main paper. These details are important for reproducibility, but they are not central to the main methodological narrative.
blocks.zh: 本节提供主要论文所报道的单任务和多任务配置所使用的培训和抽样细节. 这些细节对可复制性很重要,但并非主要方法说明的核心。

blocks.en: 3.1 Single-Task Training Details
blocks.zh: 3.1 单一任务培训详情

blocks.en: In the single-task setting, one descriptor is learned per model instance. All single-task models use the same case representation, image backbone, and fusion module. Only the final head and task-specific training configuration differ. This setup provides per-target reference results under a common input pipeline, while allowing label-specific sampling choices for strongly imbalanced targets.
blocks.zh: 在单一任务设定中,每个模型实例都学习到一个描述符. 所有单任务模型都使用相同的案例代表,图像主干,以及聚变模块. 只有最终负责人和具体任务的培训配置不同. 这种设置在一个共同的输入管道下提供每个目标参考结果,同时允许对极不平衡的目标进行针对标签的抽样选择.

blocks.en: Most descriptor targets are categorical, so we formulate them as supervised classification and address long-tailed labels during sampling. To mitigate class imbalance, we use inverse-frequency sampling together with a stratified window scheme aligned with gradient accumulation. Specifically, samples are weighted by inverse label frequency, optionally raised to a power. Rare labels are defined by a high-quantile threshold, usually 0.90, on these weights, and each accumulation window, i.e., the set of micro-batches forming one optimizer update, is constrained to contain a minimum number of rare samples. The exact sampling setup is tuned separately for each label.
blocks.zh: 大多数描述性目标都是绝对的,所以我们把它们编为监督分类,并在取样时处理长尾标签。 为了减轻阶级不平衡,我们使用反相频取样,并采用与梯度累积相适应的分级窗口方案。 具体来说,样品通过反向标签频率进行加权,可选地提升为功率. 稀有标签由高等阈值所定义,通常在这些重量上为0.90,而每个积分窗口,即形成一个优化更新器的一组微管被限制包含最少的稀有样本. 准确的采样设置为每个标签分别调取.

blocks.en: A practical advantage of the single-task setting is that the sampling policy can be tailored to each descriptor, allowing batches to approach a more balanced label distribution without additional dataset curation. In contrast, a single batch in multi-task training must serve several differently imbalanced targets at once, making long-tail mitigation more difficult.
blocks.zh: 单一任务设置的一个实际好处是,取样政策可以针对每个描述符量量身定制,使批次接近更加平衡的标签分布,而无需额外的数据集校正. 相比之下,单一批次的多任务培训必须同时服务于若干不同不平衡的目标,使长尾缓解更加困难.

blocks.en: Across all tasks, we used AdamW [ 14 ] , a Trapezoidal learning-rate scheduler [ 27 ] , and an input resolution of 640 × 640 640\times 640 pixels.
blocks.zh: 在所有的任务中,我们使用了 AdamW [14],一个 trapezoidal 学习率调度器 [27], 和输入分辨率 640× 640 640\时间 640 像素。

blocks.en: 3.2 Multi-Task Training Details
blocks.zh: 3.2 多任务培训详情

blocks.en: In the joint-training configuration, the fused case embedding is first passed through a shared pre-head MLP and then routed to task-specific heads. The shared trunk is initialized from the single-task DoF clock {}_{\text{clock}} pretrained model checkpoint. Newly added task-specific layers are initialized randomly, and missing labels are handled through task-specific loss masking.
blocks.zh: 在联合训练配置中,被引信的外壳嵌入首先通过一个共享的前头MLP来传递,再通向任务特定头. 共享的干线由单任务 DoF clock {text{ hour} 预训模式检查点初始化. 新添加的任务特有层被随机初始化,缺失的标签通过任务特有损失掩码处理.

blocks.en: Because this configuration differs from the single-task reference not only in joint supervision but also in initialization, loss balancing, sampling, and optimization schedule, the comparison should be interpreted as a comparison between selected single-task and joint-training setups under a common input representation, not as a perfectly matched ablation of multi-task supervision alone.
blocks.zh: 由于这种配置不仅在联合监管中,而且在初始化,损失平衡,取样和优化时间表中都与单任务参考不同,因此比较应被解释为在共同投入代表下对所选单任务和联合培训设置进行比较,而不是完全匹配的单多任务监督.

blocks.en: A major difficulty in the joint-training setting is that all heads must share a single sampling policy, even though the categorical targets are imbalanced in different ways. A standard inverse-frequency sampler is therefore not sufficient, because rarity is task-dependent: the same sample may be rare for one target and common for another. We therefore use task-aware weighted sampling. For each sample, we compute inverse-frequency weights for the categorical targets with available labels and take their maximum as the sampling weight. This increases the sampling probability of cases that are rare for at least one task. Sampling is then performed with replacement according to these weights.
blocks.zh: 联合培训环境的一个主要困难是,所有负责人必须共享一个单一的抽样政策,尽管明确的目标有不同方式的不平衡。 因此,标准反频取样器是不够的,因为稀有性取决于任务:同一个取样可能对于一个目标来说是罕见的,对于另一个目标来说是常见的. 因此,我们使用意识到任务的加权抽样。 对于每个样本,我们用已有的标签计算出绝对目标的反频分量,并将最大分量作为采样分量. 这增加了至少一项任务中罕见的病例的采样概率. 然后根据这些重量进行取样。

blocks.en: While this does not guarantee balanced batches for every target, it improves exposure to underrepresented cases while maintaining a single shared training stream for all heads. From epoch 6 onward, we additionally enable GradNorm [ 2 ] and Dynamic Weight Averaging (DWA) [ 12 ] to further stabilize gradient balance across task heads. These mechanisms are part of the reported joint-training recipe and should not be separated from the empirical comparison to the single-task references.
blocks.zh: 虽然这不能保证每个目标的分批均衡,但可以改善对任职人数不足案件的接触,同时保持对所有主管的单一共享培训流程。 从纪元6起,我们进一步使GradNorm[2]和动态重力(DWA)[12]进一步稳定各任务负责人的梯度平衡. 这些机制是所报告的联合培训办法的一部分,不应与经验性与单一任务参考比较分开。

blocks.en: 4 Reference Points to Prior Image-Based Work
blocks.zh: 4 先前基于图像工作的参考点

blocks.en: Most crash-severity and injury pipelines rely on structured metadata (EDR, reconstruction outputs, or curated case forms). In contrast, we study an image-based setting at real-world scale, with naturally incomplete multi-view photo sets. The closest prior image-based crash studies differ substantially in target definitions, crash-mode coverage, curation, and input modality. In particular, Silver et al. [ 25 ] combine curated real-world photographs with synthetic images generated in the Rigs of Rods simulator [ 20 ] , while Hasija et al. [ 8 ] use curated real-world cases together with vehicle metadata from NHTSA sources. We therefore report their numbers as reference points rather than as direct baselines.
blocks.zh: 大多数坠机严重和受伤管道依赖结构化元数据(EDR,重建产出,或被整理的案例表). 相比之下,我们在现实世界尺度上研究一种基于图像的设定,其中自然不完全的多视图相片集. 最近的以往基于图像的相撞研究在目标定义、相撞模式覆盖、校正和输入方式方面大相径庭。 特别是Silver等. [25] 将被整理出的真实世界相片与由Rigs of Rods模拟器所生成的合成相片结合 [20],而Hasija等. [8] 与NHTSA来源的车辆元数据一起使用被整理出的真实世界案例. 因此,我们报告它们的数目是参考点,而不是直接基线。

blocks.zh: 表4汇报了撞击平面预测的比较情况,将先前的单像撞击位置与我们从多景相机中得出的疾控中心撞击平面估计进行比较。

[ 25 ] evaluate in a curated single-image setting where the background is masked to retain only the vehicle, inputs are limited to front or rear views, and the label space is analogously reduced to front/back location. In contrast, our benchmark uses real-world crash cases represented as multi-view photo sets with natural viewpoint missingness and 4-plane coverage (front/right/left/back).

blocks.en: These numbers are included only to contextualize task difficulty. Because the label spaces, curation protocols, and inputs differ, they should not be interpreted as evidence of performance parity.
blocks.zh: 列入这些数字只是为了说明任务难度的背景。 由于标签空格,校正协议和投入不同,它们不应被解释为性能等同的证据.

Because prior work differs in data curation, crash-mode coverage, available metadata, and evaluation metrics (MAE/RMSE), these comparisons should not be interpreted as direct baselines. Instead, the table is intended to contextualize our real-world image-based setting and to show that post-crash imagery provides a usable signal that could support downstream injury, crash severity, or metadata prediction pipelines.

blocks.en: Taken together, these reference points help position our study within the body of prior image-based crash work. Because the target definitions, curation protocols, crash-mode coverage, and available inputs differ substantially across works, we use these comparisons only for context rather than as direct baselines. Within that constraint, our results provide a practical reference point for crash descriptor estimation from real-world, incomplete multi-view photo sets and motivate multimodal fusion as a natural next step, rather than establishing performance parity with prior curated or metadata-assisted settings.
blocks.zh: 综合起来,这些参考点有助于将我们的研究置于先前基于图像的崩溃工作之中。 由于目标定义,校准协议,相撞模式的涵盖范围,以及可用的投入在作品中差异很大,因此我们只将这些比较用于上下文,而不是作为直接基线. 在这一制约下,我们的成果为从现实世界、不完整多视图相机进行坠机描述估计提供了一个实用的参考点,并激励将多模式组合作为下一个自然步骤,而不是与先前的或元数据辅助设置建立性能均等。
